skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong visual direction. Use this skill for web components, pages, and applications.
skill.summary: Guides AI agents to build polished, context-specific frontend interfaces with bold visual direction.
skill.author: AJV009

No semantic security issues were found.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 asks for distinctive frontend implementation and mentions generic AI aesthetics. It does not request host inspection, system discovery, data access, or reconnaissance behavior.

content.value_statement: Many AI-generated interfaces feel generic and lack a clear visual point of view. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished, context-specific frontend work.
actual_capabilities: Defines a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Guides typography, color, motion, layout, and background choices.
Encourages working HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue interfaces.
Promotes cohesive visual systems with CSS variables and refined details.
Discourages generic AI-style layouts, fonts, and color palettes.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a complete component library.
It does not include executable scripts or automated quality checks.
Accessibility and performance still require project-specific review.
Generated results depend on the host agent and project context.

use_cases.title: Build a Branded Landing Page
use_cases.description: Create a page with a clear visual direction, refined typography, and working frontend code.

use_cases.title: Refresh an Application Screen
use_cases.description: Improve hierarchy, spacing, color, and interaction detail without changing the core workflow.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Visual Concept
use_cases.description: Explore a distinctive interface direction before committing design or engineering resources.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a polished pricing card for a small SaaS product. Include responsive HTML and CSS.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a distinctive homepage for a local architecture studio. Choose a clear aesthetic direction and implement the page.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to redesign my dashboard screen. Keep the information hierarchy, but improve typography, spacing, color, and motion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Production-Ready Experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build a responsive React interface for a data-heavy planning tool. Define the visual system, states, motion, and accessibility considerations.

output_examples.input: Build a portfolio homepage for an experimental furniture studio.
output_examples.output: A full page concept with tactile typography, asymmetric product sections, textured backgrounds, and responsive implementation guidance.
A tighter application layout with clearer hierarchy, restrained color, better spacing, hover states, and interaction states.

output_examples.input: Create a hero section for a music festival.
output_examples.output: A bold visual direction with expressive type, layered motion, vivid contrast, and production-focused component structure.

best_practices: Provide the product context, audience, and required framework before asking for implementation.
Ask for a specific aesthetic direction when brand constraints already exist.
Review accessibility, responsive behavior, and performance before shipping generated UI.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic modern page without audience or brand context.
Do not accept decorative effects that reduce readability or keyboard usability.
Do not use the skill as a replacement for product requirements or user research.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to create polished frontend interfaces with strong visual direction.

faq.question: Does it run scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prose guidance and does not include scripts or executable tooling.

faq.question: Can it work with React?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide React interfaces when the host agent and project support React.

faq.question: Is it only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide components, application screens, pages, and prototypes.

faq.question: Does it replace design review?
faq.answer: No. Human review is still needed for accessibility, usability, brand fit, and production readiness.

faq.question: Why does it mention avoiding common fonts?
faq.answer: It pushes the agent toward more distinctive typography and less generic visual output.
